verdict.rationale: Mercado Pago's CLI lets you operate payments and preferences from a single token without a browser, and Checkout Pro sends customers to a hosted payment page. Together these suggest an agent could create a checkout in one session. However, the documented payment-link feature is app/website-based, and no product or price catalog objects are evidenced. Missing for 10: product creation via the API, price object creation via the API, explicit API generation of a payment link, an evidenced single-session agent workflow tying these together, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent provision a new product, price, and payment link via the API in a single session

citations.quote: With a single token, you can operate payments, preferences, subscriptions, stores, and reports without a browser, visual interface client, or manual HTTP calls.
Redirect customers to a payment page hosted by Mercado Pago.
